title: QA run · release-18.3.0-w4-c3a (44/44) · 7fa9873f · 2026-11-02 · 41 PASS / 2 PARTIAL / 1 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWBtYWqaV8NhvUrShB

Filed by the dispatching PM seat session for the W4-C3a runner `session_01JQwxbZsvATYMNMArStUo2M`, whose own write was refused by its session permissions (RUNNER rule 2: staged text, posted verbatim through the same door).
Part of #27377 (wave 4, W4-C3a)

QA run record for the 18.3.0 release-candidate sweep, wave 4, card W4-C3a: the unpinned P1 set (plus unpinned v18.x P2) on the `api` · `cli` · `build` surface. Every clause was driven live over REST, CLI, MCP or a build, on a fresh showcase boot (or a scratch app) per item.

Result: 44 of 44 items judged. 41 PASS, 2 PARTIAL, 1 FAIL, 0 BLOCKED, 0 NOT-RUN. The one FAIL is `ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate`, with two failing clauses: one stale spec and one product defect. All five owed retests hold. Off-clause probes found six further product defects, extracted at close-out through the pm-dispatch filing gate; a seventh observation did not pass the gate and is kept in the notes below. One off-clause security observation was reported privately to the dispatching PM session and is not described here.

The per-clause verdict table (370 rows) is too long for one issue body. It is posted in the three comments directly below this body, grouped by runner, in the same column shape as wave 3.

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: `objectstack-ai/objectstack` @ `7fa9873f38f7a0158e3ce17338dcc0f446b113e3` (detached), which includes `ui/`. Its push CI (incl. Dogfood Regression Gate) and Lint were green.
- Build: `npm_config_nodedir=/opt/node22 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (23 s), then `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (16m12s, exit 0). `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` green (106 package artifacts). The console was not built: no item has a browser surface.
- Boot, per item: `OS_PORT=PORT OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT=RUN/uploads setsid pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch -p PORT -d file:RUN/data.db`, stopped by process group. `examples/app-showcase/dist/objectstack.json` was compiled once by the build and never rewritten (mtime and md5 unchanged at the end).
  - Items that install packages, compile or build an app, write the external datasource, or need an edited app booted from a scratch copy of the app (tar, node_modules symlinked back) or a scratch `create-objectstack -t blank` scaffold.
  - `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack/installed-packages/` was never created in the tree. `git status` was clean at the end. Every tree boot creates the git-ignored `.objectstack/data/showcase_external.db` (the RUNNER environment fact); it was left in place.
- Ports 41300–41439, one file DB per boot. Execution was parallel: seven runner subagents (5–7 items each, grouped by area), one boot at a time per runner. Their verdicts were accepted after the coordinator cross-checked every runner's clause rows against each item's acceptance and negative counts, and re-read the FAIL against the item history and the rulings it cites.
- Seed: stock showcase plus `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai). Personas: the demo personas (password showcase123); members minted by invite then sign-up, or by admin create-user; the `search:qa-contributor-bound-member` recipe. Each persona's identity was proven with `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` before its cells.
- Special boots:
  - `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true` for the four two-factor items (one boot, run as one sequence as backup-codes fixtures.requires[0] prescribes);
  - `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=object` for the second leg of owd-save-gate, `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE=agent` for a retired-def-refusal leg;
  - `OS_CLOUD_URL=off` for marketplace-install-local-lifecycle boot B and the runtime-config offline arm;
  - a scratch copy with the MCP upstream moved away for connector-degraded-recovery, with the dispatch proven to land on that boot (ping uptime 21.16 s against /health 24.31 s three seconds later), and a config-fault twin booted with compile from its own scratch copy;
  - `os serve` with `OS_AUTH_SECRET` and `OS_SECRET_KEY` for fresh-install-migrate-apply-first.

  `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED` was unset; no clause in this set is clock-driven.
- Timestamps (UTC, 2026-11-02): preparation 03:33, build 03:34–03:50, runners 03:51–04:17, coordinator verification and close-out drafting from 04:17.

## Derived item verdicts

PASS (41): every item in Scope except the three below.

PARTIAL (2):
- `cli.verify-verdict-exit-mapping`: clause 3's "a hole fails the run" leg is blocked(fixture). A hole is a real RLS bypass and cannot be staged on a healthy build. The RLS stack, the rls section and the staged fail side (fidelity-gap, create-failed, needs-fixture → exit 1, hardFailures 2) all passed.

FAIL (1):
- `ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate`: acceptance[4] (stale spec) and negative[1] (product defect). Clauses 0–3 and negative[0] pass.

## FAIL — reproduction rules and dispositions

### ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate · acceptance[4] — disposition: stale spec

The clause pins the pre-#27681 wholesale refusal of every `sys_*` action. Maintainer ruling 6513869839 on #27681 (letter B) and the ADR-0011 addendum "the platform identity actions an agent may reach" (ruling 6523087116 on #27900, amended by 6540309323) replaced it with a per-action `ai.exposed` opt-in, implemented by `systemObjectActionExposureError` (packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts) and `isListableAction` (packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts). Item r6 (2026-10-31) changed only the clause-1 fixture and kept this clause.

Reproduction (three fresh stock boots, 41325–41327): admin osk_ key from `POST /api/v1/keys {"name":"k"}`; MCP Streamable HTTP on `/api/v1/mcp` (initialize, then tools/call).
1. `list_actions {}` → `totalCount` 37, of which 36 have a `sys_*` objectName (sys_user, sys_session, sys_api_key, sys_organization, sys_member, sys_invitation, sys_team, sys_team_member, sys_account, sys_oauth_application, sys_sso_provider). Expected by the clause: none.
2. `run_action {"actionName":"create_api_key","objectName":"sys_api_key","params":{"name":"x"}}` → refused, nothing created, but with 'Action "create_api_key" on system object "sys_api_key" is not exposed via MCP: a system object's action is reachable only when its author exposed it to AI (ai.exposed) and list_actions lists it for you'. Expected: 'Object "sys_api_key" is a system object and its actions are not exposed via MCP'.
3. The same call without objectName → "Action 'create_api_key' is on a system object ('sys_api_key') and is not exposed via MCP — a system object's action is reachable here only when its author declares `ai: { exposed: true, description: … }` on it". Expected: "Action 'create_api_key' is on a system object and is not exposed via MCP".
4. `run_action {"actionName":"revoke_api_key","objectName":"sys_api_key","recordId":ID}` passes the guard and meets the next gate, 428 ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED. Expected by the clause: the guard refuses it.

Product side is correct (non-exposed system actions are refused with zero side effects). The clause, step 6 and acceptance[1].verify ("showcase_portfolio_snapshot is the one exposed action") need re-pointing. Carried by the wave anchor #27377 §1 ("Re-point — red rows this anchor owns"), the way wave 3's stale-spec row was; under the pm-dispatch filing gate a ledger re-point is not a card of its own (close-out `Parked-on:` line).

### ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate · negative[1] — disposition: product defect

The negative forbids list_actions advertising an action that run_action then refuses. Reproduced on three fresh boots (41325, 41326, 41327):
1. Fresh stock boot. Admin (session): `POST /api/v1/keys {"name":"r2-repro"}` → key K; `POST /api/v1/keys {"name":"throwaway"}` → id T.
2. MCP on `/api/v1/mcp` with `Authorization: Bearer K` (initialize, `notifications/initialized`).
3. `list_actions {}`: `revoke_api_key` (objectName `sys_api_key`, requiresConfirmation true) carries NO `unavailable` key, while every identity-route action in the same list carries `unavailable: {code: UNAUTHENTICATED, reason: "…accepts a signed-in session only, and this request was authenticated with an API key…"}`.
4. `run_action {"actionName":"revoke_api_key","objectName":"sys_api_key","recordId":T,"confirm":true}` → isError `{"code":"PERMISSION_DENIED","status":403,"message":"PERMISSION_DENIED: Changing an API key requires a signed-in session. … a request authenticated with an API key cannot revoke, restore or change API keys."}`. Admin `GET /api/v1/data/sys_api_key` shows T `revoked: false`.
- Expected: either the listing marks revoke_api_key `unavailable` for an API-key caller, or the run succeeds.
- Actual: listed as runnable, then refused 403; nothing changed.
- Control: the same run_action through MCP with the admin's session bearer → `ok: true`, T reads `revoked: true`.

Self-check: the osk_ key is valid (the same MCP session ran showcase_portfolio_snapshot); Mei's key shows the same listing (not wrong-persona); the refusal text names the credential kind (not a driver artifact). Mechanism: `apiForwardCredentialRefusal` classes revoke_api_key's target `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_api_key/{id}` as the data door, which its table says accepts `api_key`, while `packages/core/src/security/api-key-management-credential.ts` refuses API-key-authenticated changes to `sys_api_key`. The refusal holds and nothing changes, so this is a listing-honesty defect, not an authorization hole.

## Retests (anchor #27377 §4 and SKILL §5 trigger 2)

`node scripts/qa/retest-owed.mjs` at 7fa9873f listed five owed rows on this card's items. All five hold.
- `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix`, fix #27393: **holds.** The card's literal repro now reports `seedApplied {success:false, inserted:2, updated:0, error:"seed apply stopped at the seed for object 'seedrepro_nope': …"}`, matching the rows written; an update variant reports `inserted:1, updated:2`, also matching. Two independent boots and DBs. Unchanged on purpose (stop-at-failure is kept by the fix): a good seed sorting after the failing one is published but not applied; it is now flagged by a `seed_not_applied` probe.
- `automation.packaged-flow-subflow-disable-refusal`, fix #27395: **holds.** After `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/ID` the uninstalled package's flows answer 404 from the engine and a packaged record-trigger stops firing. R7 independently saw the crm flow leave `/automation/_status` on DELETE.
- `approvals.approver-resolution-matrix`, fix #27397: **holds.** A `user` approver naming a nonexistent user id now logs an "expanded to nobody" warning and the request routes to the administrators (admin_rescue).
- `attachments-storage.field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced`, fix #27399: **holds.** The data door drops `status`, `size`, `mime_type`, `key` and `etag` on sys_file as readonly; a never-uploaded file stays pending and the file field refuses it.
- `records-forms.validation-rule-type-matrix`, fix #24782: **holds.** The card's recipe answers 201; exactly one log line names `qa_unevaluable_warn` and says "write proceeded", none says "write rejected" or "fails closed"; the error-severity control still answers 400 and writes no row.

Wave 3's two off-clause retests on this card's items were re-confirmed: #26478 (`cli.hook-body-extraction-gates`: five builds — first, rebuild, other cwd, other checkout path, fresh copy with no dist — emit the same bundle, sha256 `11daba63…`, with no absolute path in the bundle or its decoded sourcemap) and #26480 (`platform-core.manifest-install-contract`: `^19`, `>18`, `engines.platform ^19`, legacy `^19.0.0` and `^20` each answer 422 OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE with no migrateCommand and leave no row; the older direction still offers `migrate meta --from 17`).

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

Probes took about 60 runner-minutes across the 44 items. Doors probed: every door the clauses drove, plus `/api/v1/analytics/dataset/query`, the createMany/batch doors, the sys_two_factor and sys_record_share data doors, the encoded-path install-local doors, and `os test` / `os migrate` / `os build` argument edges. Personas: admin, the demo personas, minted members, the contributor-bound member, anonymous, a garbage or rotated bearer, and osk_ keys. Boundary classes: empty string, null, missing and unknown id or name, case variants, encoded `..%2F` segments, oversize and malformed codes, opposite severity and posture (info/warning/error, password_history_count 3 vs 0, isolated vs single), readers outside scope, a trailing slash, an inverted range.

Seven product defects were found, each reproduced at least twice on independent boots. Six pass the pm-dispatch filing gate (class ①) and are extracted at close-out; number 3 does not and stays here as a note:
1. Beside `api-backend.formula-gates`: the date-arithmetic gate passes bare date subtraction (`record.end_date - record.start_date`, `today() - record.start_date`); build, validate and lint exit 0, and the field reads null or `{}` at runtime.
2. Beside `api-backend.enforce-or-remove-authoring-gates`: `/api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` refuses retired `$regex` / `$options` in `runtimeFilter` with a generic "Unsupported filter operator" instead of the RETIRED prescription naming `$icontains`.
3. Beside `cli.build-own-contract`: `os build` reports `size` and the summary KB as UTF-16 code units, not bytes (`jsonContent.length` in compile.ts; blank scaffold 2540 reported vs 2542 on disk, showcase 743.0 KB vs 750.4 KB). **Not filed:** the filing gate finds no user-visible cost beyond a 0–3% misreported size that no gate or reader acts on.
4. Beside `cli.qa-suite-execution`: `os test --url` with a trailing slash requests `//api/v1/...` and fails every HTTP scenario 404.
5. Beside `cli.migrate-meta-codemod`: `os migrate meta --json` answers an empty (`--from 18`) or inverted (`--from 19`) range exactly like a clean replay; the "replayed nothing" warning exists only on the human path.
6. Beside `records-forms.validation-rule-type-matrix`: the showcase flow `showcase_project_escalation` fails terminally (CEL `no such overload: dyn‹null› > int`) whenever a project with no budget turns red.
7. Beside `platform-core.seed-mode-matrix`: an upsert seed whose `externalId` names a field the object does not have is accepted and inserts a duplicate on every publish, silently.

Security: `identity-auth.self-service-password-reset · observed beside the clauses · security finding — detail withheld, reported to PM`. It moves no clause verdict.

Observations recorded and not extracted (judged by design, documented, or wording only):
- `/automation` answers a removed flow key with 400 VALIDATION_FAILED where `/meta` answers 422 INVALID_METADATA (deliberate in the code); view refusals add a bare root "Invalid input" issue; the unknown-key hint can suggest an unrelated key (aria → areas, defaultSort → defaults, a field with no type → "Did you mean 'url'?").
- `PUT /meta/TYPE/NAME?mode=` with any value other than `draft` saves live, as documented, so a typo such as `?mode=drafts` publishes env-wide; the same module refuses an unknown `?surface=`.
- `os test` prints a stack trace and a doubled "Error: Error:" prefix on an ordinary assertion miss (seen in wave 3 too); "Config file not found" exits 1 on the human path where other load failures exit 2 (within the clause's allowed set).
- `os migrate plan --json --database-url ''` falls back to the default DB (the payload says `kind: default`); `os migrate duplicates --object` does not narrow `liveConditions`; `os migrate organization-ownership --json` writes its plan file into the CWD by default.
- A `field` approver with an empty or unknown field logs only the node-level warning; a member's write to an external object returns datasource details before the permission refusal; any signed-in member can list connectors with their degraded reasons.
- Derived namespaces of two long ids sharing their first 20 characters collide, and the 422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT does not say the namespace was derived; a catalog install on `OS_CLOUD_URL=off` answers "OS_CLOUD_URL not configured" although it is set to `off`.
- Two-factor: disable on an unenrolled user is a no-op 200 that still rotates the session; the challenge sign-in response carries a `set-auth-token` header whose token is dead.

## Checklist-accuracy findings (for anchor #27377)

- `ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate` r6: acceptance[4], step 6 and acceptance[1].verify are stale (the FAIL above, carried by the anchor §1 re-point row). fixtures.requires[3] (`qa_ai_gated`) is now proven live: admin list_actions 38 includes it, Mei's 37 does not, teardown DELETE 200 then GET 404; the history's "Not yet run live" can close.
- `api-backend.filter-comparand-conformance` r4: acceptance[1].verify asks every refusal to quote the accepted-types sentence, but the array-for-scalar refusal comes from the operator-arity door (it names the path and prescribes `$in`/`$between`); acceptance[3] lists "a multiple field" in the null class, but a multiple `lookup` classifies as relation and is refused 400 INVALID_FIELD; no stock task row has a null number or boolean (use start_date, or seed one).
- `api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix` r7: knownGaps[0] still holds; one more seeded duplicate revenue row also makes `count_distinct(annual_revenue)` discriminating (12 vs 13).
- `api-backend.retired-def-refusal` r4: steps[2]–[4] still name `manifest.loading` as the prescription-bearing carrier; since #25767 (ADR-0087 amendment D2=A) it aged out at 18 and gets the generic refusal plus upgrade-guide pointer. Name a live carrier (the `themes` stack key, `manifest.extensions`). Registry digits: 247 entries (53 at 17, 194 at 18).
- `api-backend.enforce-or-remove-authoring-gates` r7: stored widget filters are served by `/analytics/dataset/query`; a clause leg there would have caught probe defect 2.
- `cli.verify-verdict-exit-mapping` r3: acceptance[3].verify cites `rls.summary.holes`, but verify.ts sums `rls.totals.holes` plus `rls.probe.degraded` plus `rls.positionCoverage.notRun.length`; acceptance[1]'s hardFailures formula omits those and the five opt-in checks; steps[4] could say a bare walled posture fails loudly with `WALLED_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY_UNDECLARED`.
- `cli.build-own-contract` r9, acceptance[3]: a plain thrown Error at load carries no `code` on either command; only coded throws do. Wording only.
- `cli.hook-body-extraction-gates` r8: CAPABILITY_PATTERNS has a fifth shape, `.title(…)` → `api.read`, that steps[2] does not probe.
- `cli.migrate-duplicates-inventory` r10: acceptance[3] "three entries from two migrations" is now four entries from three (sys_setting and notification-preference identity indexes added); steps[1]'s NULL `organization_id` row cannot be inserted on a freshly synced DB (column NOT NULL) without rebuilding the table to the nullable shape.
- `cli.migrate-plan-apply-json` r8, steps[8]: `meta` needs `--from` though its USAGE shows it optional; `record-currency-codes` has no stock success path (no record-mode currency field) unless the scratch config adds one.
- `cli.migrate-meta-codemod` r7: negative[6] should read "while schema refusals remain after the chain", since the 448 step-18 advisories always print beside "schema-valid"; planting the data key on `Category` is refused `[shared]` (also referenced by a seed) while `PrivateNote` writes cleanly.
- `records-forms.validation-rule-type-matrix` r7, acceptance[1]: script and conditional rules without a declared field target `_record`, which the clause prose ("not a bare object-level failure") would read as a fail.
- `identity-auth.two-factor-backup-codes` r6, fixtures.requires[2]: names the DB file only for a `--fresh` boot, not the `-d` path of the canonical boot.
- `identity-auth.two-factor-enrollment-reveal` r5, acceptance[4].verify: "the pre-verify bearer answers 401" holds only after verify-totp rotated the session.
- `identity-auth.self-service-password-reset` r5, steps[0]: the `forgetPassword: '/forget-password'` divergence in `packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts` is still unfiled.
- `automation.trigger-status-contract` r11: acceptance[5]'s "node edited away under a live pause" exit no longer answers 404, because a paused run pins its flow body (`resolveResumeTarget`, run-resume.ts) and resumes on it (200); only the deregistered-flow exit is drivable, and the clause was scored on it. 409 RESUME_CHILD_PENDING (clause 4) has no step; it is drivable with a map parent over a screen child.
- `attachments-storage.field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced` r7, fixtures.requires[2] / steps[7] / clause 5: since #27399 the admin data-door PATCH no longer clears `mime_type`/`size`; the working channel is an out-of-process write to the boot's file DB (or a system-context engine write).
- `approvals.decision-only-via-service` r5, steps[4]: the dev admin fills both slots of the unanimous slate, so one approve satisfies it and a second answers 409 INVALID_STATE.
- `integration-system.external-datasource-federated-read` r5, steps[1]: `GET /api/v1/meta` answers only types and entries; the federated objects are confirmed through `GET /api/v1/meta/object`. `GET /api/v1/datasources/showcase_external` carries no `status` (only the list does).
- `access-security.record-share-grant-revoke` r8: the last step assigns the position through the Setup UI; the API door `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position` makes it replayable without a browser.
- `access-security.sharing-rules-widen` r4, acceptance[4]: the re-enabled rule's share gets a new id; the clause (same id after the second restart) is right.
